title: Cluster Topology Change Impact Explorer — micro-interactions prototype
creator: Maya Patel
description: Prototype a focused explorer UI that lets operators preview the downstream operational, cost, and SLA impact of proposed cluster topology changes (node pools, AZ rebalancing, egress routing) before applying upgrades. The goal is a lightweight panel integrated into the cluster details page that surfaces calculated risk, expected latency change, cost delta, and a compact rollout plan with rollback recommendations.
comments: 2026-02-22 — Kickoff: aligned with PM and Eng on scope. PM requested cost delta by billing SKU and an uptime risk band. Eng flagged that current runtime cannot simulate KV cache warming reliably; proposed an empirical estimator instead.

2026-02-28 — Early prototype (Figma v0.2) uploaded. Micro-interactions added for 'drill into impact' and 'compare two topologies' flows. Design review notes: reduce cognitive load in summary card, emphasize mitigation actions.

2026-03-04 — UX review with Priya Desai and Liam Chen. Priya suggested showing A/B rollout durations and expected per-tenant latency percentiles; Liam requested clearer mapping of topology changes to autoscaling triggers.

2026-03-07 — Eng feedback: estimator requires inputs: baseline token distribution, typical concurrency, and KV warmup cost. Decided to pull recent 7-day telemetry from Console dashboards for baseline estimates and present a confidence interval instead of hard numbers.

2026-03-09 — Updated prototype (Figma v0.5) includes: confidence bands, cost delta broken down by compute/egress, and a compact rollback checklist. Requested product sign-off before handing to front-end for exploratory implementation.
2026-03-12 — PM sign-off pending small copy edits and an accessibility check for the risk heatmap colors. Assigned Evan to prepare handoff spec for frontend and telemetry owners.
Follow-ups: schedule a 30-min sync with billing team (ENG-21456) and runtime telemetry owner (ENG-21600) to validate estimator inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive prototype in Figma demonstrating: select topology change, compare baseline vs candidate, and show summarized impact card
Summary card presents: uptime risk band, latency p50/p95 delta estimate, compute cost delta, and recommended rollout plan
Design includes micro-interaction patterns for expanding detailed lineage (what tenants/pools are affected) and an accessible color palette for risk visualization
Handoff artifact with a telemetry contract that lists required metrics and a confidence model for estimates
design_decisions: Use a compact summary card as primary surface; users can expand to a side panel for full lineage and mitigation steps
Show ranges (confidence intervals) instead of absolute single-value predictions to reflect estimator uncertainty
Break cost delta into compute, storage, and egress to help operators make trade-offs quickly
Include an automated suggested rollout plan (canary %, duration, rollback trigger) derived from historical cluster incident rates
tradeoffs: Precision vs speed: a lightweight estimator is faster but less precise than full simulation; we chose a telemetry-driven estimator to keep UI responsive
Information density vs cognitive load: detailed lineage is available in expanded view rather than the summary to avoid overwhelming operators
Privacy: using aggregated tenant telemetry restricts per-customer prediction granularity; documented as a known limitation in PRD
